name: 거리 시계 기둥(무쇠 기둥 + 둥근 시계 북 — 넓은 녹청 뚜껑이 위에서 보인다)
label: steampunk-city/sp-clock-post

answer.main_body: street clock drum and post with verdigris cap
answer.evidence: The top verdigris lid/cap shows a clearly visible sloped top surface from row 2 down to row 8 (approx 7 rows tall) crowned by a small finial, drawn in proper 3/4 top-down perspective over the clock cylinder and domed base.

answer.main_body: street clock head with green patina cap and clock drum
answer.evidence: The top of the clock structure features a broad green patina cap shown from an overhead 3/4 perspective spanning rows 2 to 8 (7 rows tall) with a finial, properly revealing its upper surface above the clock face.

answer.main_body: street clock post with drum and verdigris cap
answer.evidence: The green copper cap atop the clock drum is clearly viewed from a 3/4 top-down angle, showing roughly 6 rows of foreshortened top surface (rows 2-7) adorned with a finial, and the circular base also displays a foreshortened top dome (rows 38-43).

answer.main_body: clock drum with verdigris cap on pillar
answer.evidence: The clock head is topped with an elliptical verdigris cap viewed from above across rows 2–7 (6 rows of visible top dome surface), accented with a finial. The circular base also shows a foreshortened top surface across rows 38–42.
